title: Seat Credit Against an Upgrade into First
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — credit for a seat already paid on the segment upgraded into First.** A seat paid on a segment that is then upgraded into First earns a **seat credit** taken off the First upgrade charge.

## The seat standing

The seat credit follows the seat standing on the upgraded segment, that is the latest seat charge recorded for the segment less every refund entry against that charge.

## The credit

| Seat standing on the upgraded segment | Seat credit |
|---|---|
| Extra-legroom seat | Its whole standing amount |
| Preferred seat | 0.5 (half) of its standing amount, rounded to the cent |
| Standard seat, or no paid seat | Nothing |

## How the credit is taken

The seat credit is taken off the First upgrade price only after every rate that multiplies that price has acted on it; the result is never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Latest seat charge on the segment | Refund entries against it | Standing amount | Seat credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Extra-legroom, 89.00 | One of 20.00 | 69.00 | 69.00 |
| Preferred, 39.00 | None | 39.00 | 19.50 |
| Preferred, 45.00 | One of 15.00 | 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Standard, 25.00 | None | 25.00 | Nothing |
| No seat charge | — | — | Nothing |

*Floor at zero (hypothetical).* A priced First upgrade of 60.00 dollars less a seat credit of 69.00 dollars gives a charge of 0.00, never a negative amount.
